title: California Form 540 — California Resident Income Tax Return — 2024
rationale: Full-year California resident return. Federal AGI of $322,600 is increased by $36,000 for California's nonconformity to the federal §199A QBI deduction (Schedule CA line 8z column C), yielding California AGI of $358,600. California itemized deductions ($23,000 charitable) exceed the MFJ standard deduction ($11,080), so itemized deductions are used. Tax is computed under 2024 Schedule Y. Exemption credit is provisional pending verification of the FTB pre-printed amount.
